description: A deterministic supervised, translation-tolerant denoiser. It learns the ocular residual (mixture minus clean target) from multiscale Gaussian bands, local envelopes, derivatives, position, and segment-level spectral/statistical features using histogram gradient boosting with per-segment weights aligned to relative RMSE. A diagonal DCT-domain Wiener estimate provides a complementary linear baseline. A fixed segment holdout selects residual smoothing and blend weights by mean per-segment relative RMSE; the nonlinear model and DCT filter are then refit on all training segments.
